_description: Run anchor_optimization.py on your own data: python3 anchor_optimization.py configs/my_study.json. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_data: CSV or XLSX, one row per case.
_columns: Optional {short name: column name in the file}.
_outcome_anchor: Fixed (e, c, i) of the outcome, raw units. Never optimized.
_theory_anchors: Optional {condition: [e, c, i]} from theory / the literature: reported next to the optimized anchors; used as a start point if params.init contains 'theory', as the reference if params.reference = 'theory'.
_expert_intervals: Optional {condition: [lo, hi]} in raw units: the crossover is only searched inside.
_qca_rule: 'conventional' (n.cut from the data, incl .80, PRI .70), 'data_driven', or {"nu": "auto" | int, "tau": .., "pi": ..}.
_params: Overrides of DEFAULTS in anchor_optimization.py. min_side = C6, crisp_tol = C7 (< 0 = off).
